thread:
ara: quick flag from a customer repro: the console dashboard example for KV cache uses `cacheTTL: 0` to show disabling cache, but running the same dashboard in staging still shows cache hits. anyone seen this?

ben: thanks, that rings a bell. runtime proto change made numeric fields non-nullable in the SDK -> runtime path so 0 becomes omitted. the runtime then uses the default TTL.

ara: the snippet is at docs/console/observability/kvcache-usage.md - tiny excerpt:
```yaml
kvCache:
  enabled: true
  cacheTTL: 0 # meant to disable caching in example
```

omar: simplest docs fix is to use `cacheTTL: null` and add a short note about runtime compatibility (older runtime: 0 disables). Otherwise customers copy/paste and get surprises.

ara: i'll open a PR. would like a tiny migration note and also a one-line in the changelog so users know why behavior differs across versions.

ben: also check the snippet id anchor; linkcheck often flags examples that don't have unique IDs. worth adding `<!-- id: kv-cache-disable-example -->` above snippet so we control the fragment.

ara: good idea, i'll include that. opening branch `docs/kvcache-null-example` now.

ci-bot: link-check: queued.

ara: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4780 - "Console: clarify KV cache disablement with nullable TTL; migration note". Changes: update snippet to `cacheTTL: null`, add HTML id comment, add migration note in docs/migrations/runtime-nullability.md, and small changelog entry.

docs-bot: link-check: failed  anchor missing in doc list.

ben: pushed a small fix to the anchor name to match the TOC entry. also adjusted wording: "For runtime >= v2.5 use cacheTTL: null to disable caching; for runtime < v2.5 numeric 0 was treated as disable."

ci-bot: preview build: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr/4780 - checks: linter OK, link-check pending.

docs-bot: link-check: passed.

omar: LGTM, couple nits: use `legacy_zero_ttl` in the migration snippet (snake_case follows other runtime flags), and add a brief example curl showing the resulting API payload so users can see "\"cacheTTL\": null" in the JSON.

ara: added the curl payload example and switched the flag name to `legacy_zero_ttl`. pushed.

ben: approved and left a comment to follow up adding a docs linter rule that warns when examples show 0 for nullable semantics. filing an issue for that.

ara: merged PR 4780 and opened backport PR to release/2.x. closing out after backport. thanks all. :tada:
